name: llm-wiki
description: Create and query project wikis with optional maintenance automation.

interface.shortDescription: Create and query consent-gated project wikis.
interface.longDescription: LLM Wiki packages workflows for creating and upgrading a project-local wiki, installing Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenClaw context, researching project and main cross-project wiki knowledge, planning with wiki context, and checking package status. Persistent maintenance automation is disabled by default and requires separate explicit consent. QMD is used when available, with CLI and ripgrep fallbacks.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap an LLM wiki for this project
Upgrade this project's managed LLM wiki structure
Research wiki context for this feature
Plan this feature with wiki knowledge
Check whether llm-wiki has an update
